title: StatementValue
description: Value posted onto the Statement panel (engine-owned, GSM-spine): populated GSM statement payload conforming to the resolved archetype JSON Schema. Default ContributionResolver = `compose`: per-key merge of the inner `statement` object across competing contributions, so multiple StatementShapingKSs can populate disjoint archetype fields cooperatively (each KS posts a partial statement; engine assembles the union).

shapingMethod.description: Identifier of the shaping method (e.g. structural-extraction, llm-behavioral-lift).
